ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe features a large contiguous white region extending from the mid-section to the distal tip. Right lobe is predominantly black with a concentrated white/mottled zone in the upper central area. Central peduncle region is solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; interior angle approximately 50 degrees; depth is deep relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (ragged edge). Left lobe exhibits lower-frequency, lower-amplitude serrations with smoother segments toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to upwardly curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Group of 3-5 distinct, dark circular focal spots situated within the white/mottled region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions observed in the lower-central dark region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable raggedness and loss of geometric continuity at the far distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique stippled/mottled texture at the boundary between the white and black fields on the inner left lobe.
